message.content: Hey, I need to send a quick follow-up to the lead investor from the seed round meeting last week. Can you draft something polite but firm about sending the updated cap table?

content.text:
Sure. Here’s a draft:

Hi [Name],

Hope you’re having a good week. As discussed, I’ve attached the updated cap table reflecting the latest term sheet adjustments. Please let me know if you need any clarification on the dilution figures or the vesting schedule. Looking forward to your feedback.

Best,
Priya

message.content: Good. Make it slightly warmer. Add a line about looking forward to closing this round soon. And yes, attach the PDF.

content.text:
Updated draft:

Hi [Name],

Hope you’re having a good week. As discussed, I’ve attached the updated cap table reflecting the latest term sheet adjustments. Please let me know if you need any clarification on the dilution figures or the vesting schedule. We’re really excited about the progress and look forward to closing this round soon.

Best,
Priya

message.content: Perfect. Send it. Now, switch to home mode. I’m exhausted. I need dinner sorted. I have chicken, spinach, and rice. What’s quick?

content.text: Chicken and spinach pulao sounds perfect for a quick dinner. It takes about 20 minutes. Do you want me to pull up the recipe steps, or do you just want me to order something from your usual spot?

message.content: I want to cook. Just give me the steps. Keep it simple. No fancy spices.

content.text:
Okay. Here’s the simple version:
1. Rinse 1 cup basmati rice and soak for 15 mins.
2. Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds.
3. Add diced chicken, cook until white.
4. Add chopped spinach, salt, and turmeric.
5. Add the drained rice and 2 cups of water.
6. Cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes. Turn off and let it rest for 5 mins.
Ready when you are.

message.content: Thanks. While I cook, check my calendar for tomorrow. I have that 10 AM call with the co-founder in Hyderabad. Is there anything else I need to prep?

content.text: Tomorrow at 10 AM is your call with your co-founder. You also have a team stand-up at 9:30 AM. I’ve set a reminder for 9:15 AM to review the sprint updates so you’re ready for the stand-up.

message.content: Good. One more thing. My dad’s medication refill is due next month. Remind me on the 20th so I can call the pharmacy before they close.

content.text: Added. I’ll remind you on March 20th at 6 PM to call the pharmacy for your dad’s medication refill.

message.content: Okay, I’m going to cook now. Silence mode until 8 PM.

content.text: Understood. Silence mode activated until 8 PM. Enjoy your dinner.
